description: core's interior save corpus (conformance/saves/interior-state.json, PL.core-interior-save-state) through the save.interior.* and save.runtime.* rows, each op the calls core's reference runner (src/interior-save-corpus.ts) makes, through them; numbers held exactly (tests/runtime_save_corpus.cpp replays the file itself within its tolerance, 1e-9, and refuses its controls).

cases.name: saves-interior-state: the contract save.interior.contract states
saves-interior-state read: read: a stated interior carries layoutSeed null
saves-interior-state read: read: a stated interior with no layoutSeed (Unreal's writer at 22f657b) reads as stated, layoutSeed null
saves-interior-state read: read: a seeded interior keeps its seed
saves-interior-state read: read: layoutSeed 0 is a seed, not the sentinel
saves-interior-state read: read: a layoutSeed of 2.5 (not an integer) reads as null, stated
saves-interior-state read: read: a string layoutSeed reads as null, stated
saves-interior-state read: read: outside, interiorState null
saves-interior-state read: read: a record with no buildingId is not an interior (null)
saves-interior-state read: read: a missing name and type read as ''
saves-interior-state load: load: inside a stated interior, a point of its frame is kept (interior frame)
saves-interior-state load: load: inside a stated interior, upstairs (floor 1, y 3.9 of 6 m) is kept
saves-interior-state load: load: inside a stated interior, standing in the entrance (z −0.3, within the 0.5 m tolerance) is kept
saves-interior-state load: load: a stated interior carrying an engine-frame position (Unreal's 5 km bay) is not kept: the player arrives at the entrance, facing in
saves-interior-state load: load: a stated interior carrying a world-frame position (by the building) is not kept: the entrance
saves-interior-state load: load: a stated interior carrying a position above its height (y 7 of 6 m) is not kept
saves-interior-state load: load: a stated interior with no entrance and a position not in its frame: inside, no stated point (the host places the player)
saves-interior-state load: load: an interior with no stated height is floors × 3 m high: y 6.4 of 6 m is kept (within 0.5 m)
saves-interior-state load: load: an interior with no stated height is floors × 3 m high: y 6.6 is not kept
saves-interior-state load: load: a locked door does not keep a load out (a load is not a key check): the entrance
saves-interior-state load: load: a seeded interior is not re-entered: outside, at the door, facing out
saves-interior-state load: load: a building whose world states no interior: outside, at its door
saves-interior-state load: load: a building not in this world: outside, no stated point
saves-interior-state load: load: outside (interiorState null): the saved world-frame position is kept
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: saved inside a stated interior, loaded inside it at the same interior-frame point
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: a game reporting Unreal's shape (no layoutSeed) is written with layoutSeed null and loads inside
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: a seeded interior keeps its seed through the save; the load puts the player outside at the door
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: outside, interiorState null is written null and loads outside at the saved world point
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: a game reporting no interiorState carries the stored one (absent is not null)
saves-interior-state round_trip: round trip: an engine-frame position saved inside is written as given; the load does not keep it (the entrance)
